card.what: 57 mm swivel ratchet block with on/off switches, 10 mm line: the mainsheet's last block on the Sunfish (standing on a deck eye forward of the cockpit) and the ILCA (on its post)
card.boats: Sunfish (layouts/sunfish.json, with the stand-up spring), ILCA 7 (layouts/ilca7.json)
card.distance: arm's reach: the helm's hand is on the sheet that runs out of it
card.before: kit Ratchet57 from _block_parts (Oct 2026): round flat cheeks with six holes, a wire strap over the top, no shackle, 83 mm

references.use: outline and proportions (square-on side view of a 57 mm moulded-cheek block; proportions only). Not fetched this round: Wikimedia refused the cloud (HTTP 429), so the outline and aspect checks wait for it
the mainsheet led from the boom down to the front of the cockpit (in use, measuring only: people in the photo)
where it goes: the mainsheet eyestrap on the deck forward of the cockpit, aft of the daggerboard well; the switch's on/off
references.url: Sunfish rigging manuals (LaserPerformance 2018, SERO 2025 SOL); SERO's ratchet block listing (interchangeable with Sunfish part 91333)
Harken 2135 57 mm Carbo ratchet block with swivel: Rooster Sailing 128613 and Sound Boatworks list 103 mm (4 1/16 in) overall; Defender lists 10 mm max line, 85 g

sizes.name: Overall length, top of the shackle to the foot of the cheeks

features.text: Moulded teardrop cheeks, round round the sheave, a short flat head
Cheeks matte black plastic, the sheave grey aluminium, fittings bright stainless
Faceted ratchet sheave (flats in the groove floor) with a round groove for 10 mm line
An on/off switch on each cheek
Hollow centre with a stainless axle liner and bearing race
Swivel post with a collar on the head
Shackle with its pin and pin head
Stand-up spring round the shackle and swivel (the Sunfish's, standup=True)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
